# Vimbre

Vimbre is a shared decision log for teams. It keeps each decision with its reason, date, owner and next step, so whoever covers for a colleague, joins a team or takes over a role can see what happened and what to do first. It works next to the tools you already use.

Vimbre is for HR managers, team leads and directors. It helps when someone is on leave, leaves the company, joins a team or changes role, because the person stepping in can see recent decisions, open work and who to speak to.
